newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS WEEK STRONGER ON CURRENCIES.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS WEEK STRONGER ON CURRENCIES.

text.p: The Zimbabwe dollar was quoted firmer on most key units at the close of a rather dull Friday interbank session, dealers said.
"The market was a bit quiet...a bit boring really. There wasn't much trade today," one dealer commented.
"But there was quite a bit of activity in the early morning with some banks off-loading (foreign currency) and the dollar appreciated up to 11.3800 with some even quoting 11.3700," she added.

Dealers said the local dollar however weakened slightly on the back of some last-minute buying towards the end of the day to finally close at 11.3825/3925 against the U.S. dollar; still firmer compared to Thursday's 11.3900/4000.

Against the crosses, the local unit was also stronger on the mark at 6.4555/4565 from 6.5100/5140 and at 2.5000/5010 from 2.5030/5040 versus the rand but was quoted softer on sterling at 19.3000/3280 compared to 19.2260/2550.
